subject: Re: Activation Clustering kickoff - interpretability for the debugging offering
body:
Hi Bao, Anders,

Status ahead of the April 30 decision. Repro was smooth - the CIFAR-10 notebook flow worked out of the docker container basically first try, and the internal-model spike (our retail-vision classifier) produced clusters by March 18.

Results on the two debugging cases, using Kaia's rubric: case 1 (mislabeled-lookalike failure) was a clear win - the activation clusters isolated the confusing concept group in under an hour, versus roughly a day of manual slicing last time we debugged that model. Case 2 (texture-bias failure) was a partial win: the relevant cluster existed, but you had to already suspect texture to spot it, so Kaia scored it "confirmatory, not discovering."

The risk for productization: cluster granularity is a per-model knob, and bad settings produce plausible-looking but useless concepts. The June sprint needs concept-quality metrics as its first deliverable, before any customer-facing polish - otherwise we're shipping a tool that's convincing when it's wrong.

My vote is a green light with that ordering constraint.

Rafael
